---
title: "showcase"
description-meta: "Things worth showing — projects, photographs, books and odds and ends."
page-layout: full
toc: false
listing:
  id: showcase
  # One file per item, in items/. Cards are ordered newest first.
  contents: items
  sort: "date desc"
  # Custom template: the built-in grid card is fixed-shape, and the point of a
  # showcase is that each item chooses its own HTML.
  template: _card.ejs.md
  # `width` and `card` are not fields Quarto knows about; naming them here is
  # what makes them available to the template as item.width / item.card.
  fields: [title, date, width, card, link, image]
  page-size: 60
---

A place for things that do not belong anywhere else on the site — projects,
photographs, books, and the occasional oddity.
